I counted about 13 to 15 slices. Each slice weighs about 10 to 12 g, so the total is about 150 g. The footprint is about 100 cm² at an average height of 1.5 cm, which gives about 150 cm³. With gaps between the slices, that comes to about 110 to 130 g. I'll use 125 g.

The carrots look glazed, with a light sheen of butter or oil. I'll count that as a small separate item of about 4 g.
